summary: Find typographic and special characters by name, such as the em dash, curly quotes, arrows, math, currency and the Mac's keyboard symbols, ready to copy.
notes: Works offline and reads no websites. Search by name, alias, HTML entity or code point; each row shows the character's name, code point and HTML entity. Volant trims spaces from rows, so invisible characters such as the no-break space copy their HTML entity instead.
